notes.title: New trailer & we're on OTK Expo!
notes.notes:
Great news! Divinum is participating in the OTK Expo Steam event, and our new trailer was shown on the Expo pre-show's livestream! The trailer is now available on the store page as well, showcasing more of Divinum's diverse combat and game world, and revealing a new catacomb boss—check it out and share with your friends! Some screenshots and other media on the store page also got updated.

notes.title: New gameplay teaser & playtest applications open!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Happy to tell that we're making a lot of progress with the development. We wanted to share a new teaser trailer showcasing the game world, combat and a bit of progression systems.
Check it out on Divinum's store page, and help us by sharing it with your friends!

Also, we recently opened playtest (aka closed alpha/beta test) signups to be able to gather people's feedback on how the game actually plays. To apply for the future playtest, press "Request access" on Divinum's store page. When the playtest is launched, you'll be notified. (Participation is not guaranteed and amount of total invites will depend on how much testing is deemed necessary.)

notes.title: Development of Divinum resumes!
notes.notes:
For the most part, Divinum has been a solo developer effort. I never intended to abandon it completely, but as much as I wanted to keep working on it, personal and financial reasons made it impossible, forcing me to pause indefinitely. Not delivering on time and failing to keep everyone updated caused a lot of anxiety, but I felt it would be best for my well-being not to think about the project until I was truly ready to continue.

Now, after many years, there are enough resources and a small team, and the game’s vision has become significantly clearer. In the last few months, we've made huge progress, which is reflected on the fully overhauled store page, featuring up-to-date screenshots, an updated description, and a gameplay video!

Wishlist and follow to stay updated on upcoming playtests, demo, and release date announcement!
